item: Stiftungsratspraesident (President of the Foundation Council) of eduction21 (eduction21, foundation for education for sustainable development / BNE)
detail: Took over the presidency of the foundation council of eduction21 from Zurich government councillor Silvia Steiner on 1 May 2018; the role was tied to his function as Basel education director. He was succeeded by Lucerne education director Armin Hartmann after stepping down as Basel education director.

item: Board member of the Trinationaler Eurodistrict Basel (TEB)
detail: Represents Basel-Stadt on the board of the Trinational Eurodistrict Basel, a cross-border cooperation body in the Basel region. Mandate tied to his government office.

item: Former member of the student fraternity Zofingia
detail: Former member of the students' fraternity (Studentenverbindung) Zofingia.

item: Board member (Vorstand) of E.E. Zunft zum Schluessel, Basel
detail: Board member of the Basel guild E.E. Zunft zum Schluessel.
